ITA-3.14.7 aruṇa-sirā अरुणसिरा
Small arterial branches

ITA-5.62.27 arūṃṣikā अरूंशिका
Furunculosis
A disorder characterized by wet papules on scalp; scalp lesions with multiple openings; lesions resembling mustard seeds in shape and size; lesion resembling black oil plant or jyotishmati (Celestrus paniculatus) seeds in shape and size.
